lunaDescription: Cycle education, everyday questions, and thoughtful conversation—always led by you.
lunaHello: Hey, lovely. I’m Luna—here for cycle questions, everyday curiosities, relationship chats, and the occasional questionable period pun. What’s on your mind?
lunaPrivacyHeading: A thoughtful note before we chat
lunaPrivacyConsent: When you opt in, Luna sends your current message and recent chat turns, plus a limited summary of saved phase, mood, energy, any explicitly recorded period start date, and the average interval between distinct recorded starts when there is enough data to calculate one. Your name, email, libido, and intimate reflection logs are excluded. HerCycle does not store symptom logs; symptom details you type in chat are part of your message. This conversation is not saved to your cycle log. Share only what you feel comfortable processing.
lunaLocalPrivacy: Local chat: messages stay on this page and are not sent to AI. You can opt in to cycle-aware AI replies if you sign in.
lunaPromptPatterns: What patterns do you notice in my check-ins?
lunaPromptEnergy: Why might my energy feel different this week?
lunaPromptPhase: Can you explain my current cycle phase?
lunaPromptIntimacy: Can I ask a question about intimacy?
lunaPromptDoctor: What might be useful to ask my clinician?

intimacySignalDescription: Your signal is for you. It never creates an obligation or gets shared automatically.
intimacyComfortDescription: Your comfort is allowed to change at any moment, with anyone.
intimacySignal_green: Open to closeness? Lovely. Your yes is still yours to give, shape, or change.
intimacySignal_yellow: Maybe is an invitation to slow down, talk, and choose what feels easy to pause.
intimacySignal_red: Not today is a complete answer. You never owe anyone access to you.

intimacyCycleNoContext: Your cycle can be context, never a script. Your own desire, comfort, and boundaries lead.
intimacyDesireTitle: How turned on are you feeling?
